verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that Lowenstein Sandler serves an llms.txt at its root (HTTP 200). That file holds an agent-readable firm overview covering offices, deal volume and practice-area descriptions such as Venture Capital Investments and Venture M&A, so an AI-native user can point an agent at it directly. Missing for 10: any richer agent-oriented docs beyond the single llms.txt (e.g., llms-full.txt or a machine-readable API spec, since the OpenAPI probe paths all 404), and independent corroboration of the file's depth or upkeep.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Representation of venture funds and other investors in priced rounds, convertible instruments, and follow-on investments.
